name: Palantir
scope: Supply chain, manufacturing and industrial news. Defence and government news is out of scope UNLESS it involves supply chain or logistics.
keep_even_if_off_topic: Foundry or AIP platform announcements in any vertical — the ontology concept is the nearest thing anyone sells to TADA's Digital Duplicate
Ontology or digital-twin positioning statements — direct overlap with TADA's central claim
Commercial (non-government) expansion news — their commercial growth is the competitive threat
Defence logistics and military supply chain — military logistics IS supply chain and the techniques transfer to industrial
Manufacturing or industrial customer wins however framed, including defence manufacturers, if it is production operations
Partnerships with ERP or cloud platforms (SAP, AWS, Microsoft, NVIDIA)
Executive statements on autonomous decision-making or AI agents — contradictable by TADA's theses
Acquisitions of anything data, AI or supply-chain adjacent
Pricing or packaging changes for the commercial business
Earnings commentary ONLY where it names commercial or manufacturing traction

name: SAP
scope: Supply chain, IBP, Business Network, Ariba, EWM and manufacturing. Also anything signalling a strategic shift in how SAP positions AI, autonomy, agents or decision-making, whatever product line it is attached to. HR, CRM and finance product news is out of scope.
keep_even_if_off_topic: Company-wide AI or agent announcements (Joule, autonomous agents) even when framed cross-portfolio rather than supply chain
S/4HANA maintenance deadline changes (2027/2030) — the forcing event behind modernisation budgets TADA sells into
Pricing or licensing model shifts such as consumption-based or AI credits
Business Technology Platform or data fabric announcements — competes with Digital Duplicate positioning
Acquisitions of any AI, data or automation company
Cloud and compute partnerships (NVIDIA, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks)
CEO, CTO or Chief AI Officer changes
Public positions on deterministic versus probabilistic AI, or agent governance
Product-org layoffs or restructuring
Analyst placements in non-supply-chain categories

name: Lyric
scope: Supply chain decision intelligence company, legal name ChainBrain Inc., product Lyric Studio. Ignore any other company or product named Lyric — music services, lyrics sites and unrelated firms.

name: Blue Yonder
scope: Ignore unrelated uses of the phrase 'blue yonder' — it appears in music, aviation and gaming contexts.

name: FourKites
scope: Moved from fourkites.com to fourkites.ai — watch for coverage under either domain.

name: Pelico
scope: Manufacturing supply chain operations platform, French-headquartered — watch European trade coverage as well as US. Ignore unrelated uses of the name.
